raw_response:
1. The models' performances vary relative to the 70% benchmark: LLaMA-3-8B-it exceeds it on GSM-8K and MMLU, while Ours (Iterative RLHF) exceeds it on GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, ARC, and MBPP. Most other scores fall below 70%.

2. On TruthfulQA, Ours (Iterative RLHF) scores approximately 60%, matching LLaMA-3-8B-it’s score — there is no visible performance difference between the two models on this dataset.

3. The chart does not provide statistical significance information (e.g., error bars, p-values, or confidence intervals), so the statistical significance of performance differences cannot be determined from this figure alone.
